$comment: The interim terrain's height field (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.3, docs/WORLD_GENERATION.md): how the ground rises inland and falls offshore, and the noise relief over it. Heights in metres above sea level, distances and wavelengths in metres, octaves of a fractal sum whose amplitude is about ±amplitude. Prototype content (§6.1). Changing any value changes the terrain a seed generates: bump the generator version, regenerate the goldens (`cargo run -p dwell-worldgen --example goldens`) and ship it on a new compatibility line. Run `node shared/worldgen/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails on stale output. Phase 17's terrain definitions (ADR 0026) take this over.

steps.$comment: Half-height branch (HALF_HEIGHT_GRID.md §4): where the ground is at least fromSlope steep (m per m, across a 4 m lattice cell), heights snap to whole multiples of height (m), so steep ground is 1 m steps of two ½ m cells that the generation rule tops with 45° ramps. height 0 turns it off.
